name: leaf
description: Generative UI: the agent builds the page your task needs, writes new widgets when the project calls for them, and answers your comments and edits over a messaging and collaboration bus.

hooks_module.title: Wake the session from Leaf's hooks module (experimental)
hooks_module.description: Keep Leaf's watch between turns in its Claude Code hooks module rather than a background Stop hook. The module goes on watching after a turn you interrupt, but each wake shows in the conversation as a prompt from the plugin. Leaf's line above the prompt shows either way.
